Audusse et al. assume a homogeneous numerical flux with its own positivity and entropy properties; the local HLL positivity proof checks the actual assigned wave speeds and CFL.

NA26's actual theorem is scalar and source-free. The vector shallow-water weak passage is proved locally.
The PE05 weak-limit theorem assumes strong local L1 convergence and uniform bounds; no compactness or entropy admissibility follows.
